html:
Perks › Legendary

Time Loop

Legendary perk · Turn

Once per round, arm it before you play. If that play scores, immediately play again.

In-game card text

How it works

Arm Time Loop before you play. If that play scores, you immediately take another turn.

  • The charge is only spent when the armed play scores. If it doesn't, the arming ends and the charge is kept for later.
  • Each copy gives one use per hand.
  • If the armed play was your last bone, the hand simply ends.
  • With Stumble, the extra turn begins with Stumble's required draw.

At a glance

RarityLegendary
TypeTurn
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itComplete its three career trials (Spend 2 hours at the table; Finish 5 matches; Play 300 bones), then unlock it for 1,500 Bone Bucks.
